narrative_heading: The path from idea to product
narrative_intro: A software project is not just code. It gains value through solid structure, clear flow and a trustworthy user experience.
narrative_quote: Good software is not only a working build. It is an understandable, trustworthy and manageable experience over time.

narrative_cards.title: Planning & Design
narrative_cards.description: Every project starts with understanding needs. Without proper planning, clean design and clear user flow, a strong digital product cannot emerge.

narrative_cards.title: Development & Structure
narrative_cards.description: Turning design into a working product requires clean code, organized structure and a sustainable development approach.

narrative_cards.title: Launch & Improvement
narrative_cards.description: Real value appears after a product goes live. Speed, compatibility, updates and ease of use must be tracked continuously.

narrative_cards.title: Ongoing Growth & Support
narrative_cards.description: A digital product keeps evolving after launch. Updates, improvements and adjustments to new needs keep the system running efficiently over time.

client_feedback_subtitle: Real feedback from real collaborations — clarity, reliability, and pace matter.

client_feedback_items.name: Ahmet K.
client_feedback_items.quote: Communication stayed clear from day one. Deliveries were predictable and the scope did not quietly drift.

client_feedback_items.name: Elif S.
client_feedback_items.quote: We ended up with a store we could run day to day. Small fixes landed quickly without extra noise.

client_feedback_items.name: Murat T.
client_feedback_items.quote: Technical choices were explained with trade-offs, not jargon. That made it easier to sign off with confidence.

client_feedback_items.name: Defne A.
client_feedback_items.quote: The portfolio structure is easy for visitors to scan. Pages still feel fast on phones.

client_feedback_items.name: Onur Y.
client_feedback_items.quote: Straightforward scope. When something was not realistic, he flagged it early instead of later.

client_feedback_items.name: Can D.
client_feedback_items.quote: Solid front-end discipline. Handoff notes were usable by our team the same week.

client_feedback_items.name: Burak M.
client_feedback_items.quote: The dashboard uses plain language for supervisors. Training time stayed short.

client_feedback_items.name: Zeynep L.
client_feedback_items.quote: Collaboration was paced well and matched the direction we gave. No endless revision loops.

client_feedback_items.name: Kerem B.
client_feedback_items.quote: Field workflows were mapped sensibly. We spent less time clarifying things over email.

client_feedback_items.name: Ayşe H.
client_feedback_items.quote: Checkout feels cleaner now. Our rough numbers suggested fewer abandoned carts.

client_feedback_items.name: Emre G.
client_feedback_items.quote: Privacy-related decisions were framed with options, not buzzwords. That built trust.

client_feedback_items.name: Selin K.
client_feedback_items.quote: The mobile layout finally matches how we present work on-site to clients.

client_feedback_items.name: Hakan V.
client_feedback_items.quote: When a dependency slipped, the timeline update was honest. That was refreshing.

client_feedback_items.name: Volkan R.
client_feedback_items.quote: He cared about performance budgets. The site stayed snappy as we added content.

client_feedback_items.name: Gizem N.
client_feedback_items.quote: Saved filters on the reporting view became part of the morning routine — small but very useful.

client_feedback_items.name: Barış F.
client_feedback_items.quote: Micro-interactions are restrained. It reads serious without looking like a template.

client_feedback_items.name: Deniz C.
client_feedback_items.quote: CMS edits did not break layouts. Components behaved the way we expected.

client_feedback_items.name: Cem Ö.
client_feedback_items.quote: Analytics tags were added carefully. We did not watch site speed tank afterward.

client_feedback_items.name: Nehir P.
client_feedback_items.quote: The kickoff questions were sharper than what we heard from three previous vendors.

principles_intro_accent: what you deliberately choose not to build
value_technical_depth_desc: Working at the core of systems, not just on the surface
value_collaboration_desc: Strong results come from multidisciplinary teamwork
value_outcome_desc: Clear objectives lead to measurable results
value_selectivity_desc: Sustainable quality comes from choosing the right work
principles_final_quote: Great work starts with the right questions. And the right questions are shaped by technical depth and real-world experience.
principles_how_i_work_items: A problem is understood first, then solved.
Technical details are never separated from the bigger picture.
Documentation is the long-term memory of a project.
Testing is the only real source of trust.
principles_focus_items: Infrastructure projects that require real technical depth
The intersection of physical networks and digital systems
principles_avoid_items: Temporary fixes instead of sustainable solutions
Projects where documentation is treated as optional
